policies.title: Latvian ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Latvia's MFA says Latvian citizens need a Chad visa; Chad now requires new non-diplomatic visitor visa requests exclusively online before travel.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Latvian-passport short visitors who need a Chad visa.
Submit the new request exclusively through evisa.td before travel; standard processing is 10 working days and express processing is 72 hours.
Diplomatic and courtesy visas, and all purpose, security, documentary, carrier and final-admission requirements, remain outside this policy.

application.label: Chad official eVisa application
application.processingTime: 10 working days standard or 72 hours express.
steps: Submit the ordinary Latvian-passport visitor application through evisa.td before travel.
Travel only after visa issuance and with the required supporting documents.

conflicts.explanation: Latvia's MFA establishes Chad visa liability, while Chad's current authority requires every new non-diplomatic visa request exclusively through evisa.td before travel.
